newsitem.title: USA: Complete Management to buy doctor practice.
newsitem.headline: Complete Management to buy doctor practice.

text.p: Complete Management Inc said on Friday it agreed to buy a physician practice management company for about $7 million in cash and stock.
Chairman and Chief Operating Officer Steve Rabinovici said the business was expected to generate revenues of about $13 million over the next 12 months for the company.

The practice management company had a 30-year management contract for 30 physicians to provide management services, transcription, billing, collection and temporary staffing services to 50 medical practices in the New York area.
"This transaction is the most significant one that CMI has yet completed," Ravinovici said. "We will now have a major presence in the area north of New York City, up towards Albany, New York."
Complete Management provides management and support services in greater New York area.
